steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Oi! Corpse-face, what did you do to ${PlayerName}?! Did you kill him?!
steps.female_content: Oi! Corpse-face, what did you do to ${PlayerName}?! Did you kill her?!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief... Chief... No...
Panicking, Hecate keeps shaking your body, begging you to respond.

steps.speaker: Options
options: I'm fine. I'll be right back.

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: They can't hear you.

<size=32>In the reflection, Oak Casket stands behind them. The surrounding contamination begins to gather and Black Ring monsters emerge one after another. They close in on the two, reaching out their arms to tear at the Sinners who're paralyzed by their mental breakdown.</size>

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: Haha... You can't go back. You're already dead.

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: Why are you shocked? You demanded something from death, and your request has been granted. Weren't you prepared for this?

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: Or, do you find death different from what you imagined?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Why?

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: Since you said you made up your mind, I have something I wish to tell you too...

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: I want you to see, what death really is like...
She's smiling, but it sends a chill down your spine.

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: What did you imagine it to be like? Torment on the physical body?
Oak Casket points her gun at the reflection in the lake. In the reflection, she also steps forward and points a gun at your Sinners, but they're completely unaware.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...What are you doing?
Bang! Bang bang!!

You can't release the shackles. Realizing your inability, you immediately turn to plunge into the water to stop that cruel woman. Ripples shatter the reflection, but you're already hearing your companions' cries.

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: Or, a collapse of the mind? Shattering of dignity?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Send him... back... I beg you...
steps.female_content: Send her... back... I beg you...

steps.content: You can't see Hecate's face, but every word she says pricks your nerves. You want to find the way back, but the more you struggle, the more broken and distant their images become.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...If I've offended you, just kill me. Don't hurt them.

steps.speaker: ...And still she is made to suffer that gaze from on high.
steps.content: Are you willing to die for others? Too bad, in your current state, you can't stop anything from happening or do anything for them anymore.

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: You can only watch.
She raises her gun again and points it at the void. The ripples are still quivering, so you can't see what's happening in the other world, but it's very clear to you where she's aiming her gun at.

steps.speaker: Oak Casket
steps.content: Haha... Do you still want to fight me? You're so used to altering your fate by fighting. This time... are you going to challenge death?
